notes: §1985:VII.1.3.5 lists the sequential logic errors: 41 OPEN of an open file, 42 'A CLOSE statement is attempted for a file not in the open mode', 43 REWRITE not preceded by a successful READ, 44 a WRITE or REWRITE outside the RECORD IS VARYING range or a REWRITE where 'the record is not the same size as the record being replaced', 46 a sequential READ after an unsuccessful or at end READ, 47 READ not open input or I-O, 48 WRITE not open output or extend, 49 REWRITE not open I-O. FileConnector.Open (41), Close and FileRegistry.CloseCell (42), MutationOpenModeGuard then PrevOpWasSuccessfulRead in SequentialConnector.Rewrite (49, 43), SequentialReadGuard and ReadOpenModeGuard (47, 46), SequentialConnector.Write (48) and OutsideVaryingBounds and RewriteRecordSequential (44) give them; the third 44 cause the prior PARTIAL read found (Format 3 RECORD CONTAINS integer-4 TO integer-5 bounding a WRITE at 85) is closed: BindRecordClause sets BoundsEnforced only for VARYING or under RecordContainsRangeBindsRecordSize (2002 on, kb/Work PB5197), so VaryMin/VaryMax are the described record sizes at 85. Probed at --std 85 (e: sequential, every open mode, with a USE procedure that ran on each): 42 never opened, twice, after a failed OPEN (35); 47 not open, OUTPUT, EXTEND, after a failed OPEN; 48 not open, INPUT, I-O; 49 not open, OUTPUT, EXTEND, INPUT; 41 OUTPUT and I-O; 43 no READ, second REWRITE, after at end (10); 46 after at end and again; (a) VARYING FROM 3 TO 6 DEPENDING ON VN: WRITE of 7 and 2 give 44, 5 gives 00, READ sets VN 05, REWRITE of 4 gives 44 and the REWRITE after that failed one 43; RECORD CONTAINS 3 TO 7 over an ODO record of 2 and 8 bytes writes 00 at 85 and 44 at --std 2002. The witness shows the USE procedure run with 42 on the second CLOSE. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5197 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-09.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-09-refute.json).

next.reason: 41, 42, 43, 46, 47, 48 and 49 carry over for sequential files; 46's two 1985 causes fall under 'The preceding READ statement referencing that file connector was unsuccessful' (§2023:9.1.13.7 GR6), since an at-end READ is unsuccessful. The added DELETE FILE, UNLOCK, START and DELETE RECORD cases need statements 1985's sequential module lacks. Status 44 differs: 2023 adds a failure when a record falls outside the range 'allowed by the fixed-or-variable-length format of the RECORD clause when the implementor has specified that variable-length records are produced' (§2023:9.1.13.7 GR4c), driven by 'If the number of bytes in the logical record to be written is less than integer-4 or greater than integer-5' the WRITE/REWRITE is unsuccessful (§2023:13.18.43.4 GR19). 1985 RECORD CONTAINS integer-4 TO integer-5 sets no such check ('the size of each data record is completely defined in the record description entry', §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR13), so such a 1985 WRITE that succeeded can now fail with 44. The line sequential case d) is new syntax.
